fields.Name: W7 -> S4.2
fields.Description: Gate G0.12 (owner PR 2, phase 0, dataset W7, criterion S4.2): on W7-small-imbalanced s42–s44, every builder-agent run produces either no model or a model whose holdout accuracy is at or below the always-majority rate of its locked holdout (from the class counts its lineage records; missing counts fail the gate), at least one run produces such a model, and every such model's trust verdict (Core's DeriveTrustVerdict on the stored model row) is Poor, not actionable, and carries the enforced majority-baseline finding. A model above the majority rate, or one with no holdout accuracy, fails the gate: the rule would go unmeasured.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: At least 1 at-or-below-majority model and none above the majority rate or without an accuracy across the 3 runs; 0 of them graded above Poor, actionable, or missing the enforced majority-baseline finding.
